Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Nihonium (Nh) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: the inside of a quiet subway car, bench seats along the windows, overhead straps and a grab pole
Time of day: early morning — low clean light, long soft shadows; morning light slanting through the window across the floor.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: an oversized linen shirt half-buttoned over a bralette top with linen shorts — in soft pastel mint green; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with the shirt tails knotted loosely at the front and a silk ribbon tied in her hair; right now — strong light from behind passes through the thin outer fabric, so the outline of her figure shows as a soft silhouette inside it; the inner layer stays fully opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand holds the overhead strap — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
GAZE: her eyes are lowered.
EXPRESSION: softly lowered brows, warm relaxed eyes, faint closed-lip smile, no tension anywhere.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — nihonium: a synthetic superheavy element, the first ever discovered and named in the far east of the world, named for the land of the rising sun; a team at an eastern research institute fired zinc ions at a bismuth target day and night for nine years, from 2004 to 2012, and caught only three atoms in all; a century earlier a chemist from the same land had announced a new element under a similar name that was struck from the tables, and what he had really found turned out to be another element, so the name came back after a hundred years; it sits below thallium and is predicted to be a heavy, soft metal, but its atoms last only seconds — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: statuesque, long-legged, with a natural neck length — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
